verdict.rationale: Proxy handling is a fair question for a cloud browser platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions proxies, proxy chains, or automatic retry when a request is blocked. The CAPTCHA-handling claim (docs-10) is an adjacent anti-bot feature, not proxy failover, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically retry through a chain of different proxies when anti-bot detection blocks a request
